metadata.question: Did nighttime light intensity in Al Bayda, Libya, decrease on September 13, 2023, compared to September 8, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or VIIRS/DNB/DAILY) - For specific dates (Sept 8 and Sept 13, 2023), I need daily data - Location: Al Bayda, Libya (approximately 32.76°N, 21.76°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights typically don't need cloud masking - Focus on the avg_rad_vcm band (average radiance) 3. Logic: - Get mean radiance for both dates - Compare: if Sept 13 < Sept 8, then Yes (A), otherwise No (B) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Al Bayda, Libya location const alBayda = ee.Geometry.Point([21.76, 32.76]); const region = alBayda.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city center // Define dates const date1 = '2023-09-08'; const date2 = '2023-09-13'; // Try VIIRS nighttime lights - daily composites // Note: Daily data may not be available, so we'll try monthly first let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(alBayda) .filter(ee.Filter.date('2023-09-01', '2023-09-09')) .select('avg_rad'); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(alBayda) .filter(ee.Filter.date('2023-09-01', '2023-09-14')) .select('avg_rad'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection 1 (Sept 8): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Collection 2 (Sept 13): ${size2} images`); // Monthly data won't have specific daily resolution // We need to use the same monthly composite for both dates if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Monthly data not suitable for daily comparison'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Since monthly composites span the entire month, both dates would use same image // This makes daily comparison impossible with monthly data // Nighttime lights daily data is not readily available in GEE for specific dates // Alternative: Check if there's annual or monthly trend data const img = col1.first(); const stats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log('Stats:', stats); const meanVal = stats.avg_rad_mean; const count = stats.avg_rad_count; if (count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (meanVal === null || meanVal === undefined) { console.log('Invalid calculation result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Since VIIRS monthly composites don't provide daily resolution // we cannot compare specific dates (Sept 8 vs Sept 13) console.log('VIIRS monthly data lacks daily resolution for date-specific comparison'); console.log('C1'); } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
